video.title: AI欧腐《我的死对头龙王把我掰弯了/My Dragon Nemesis Turned Me Gay》
video.desc:
Human crown prince Ryan infiltrates the dragon realm to prevent war, feigning allegiance to villains to gather conspiracy evidence. He and his longtime foe Black Dragon King Derek uncover their fated childhood bond. United, they fight the powerhungry Kaos and remnant fallengod forces, break a fatal blood curse, overcome divisive schemes, resolve ancient hatreds between humans and dragons, and achieve genuine peace alongside mutual love.
人类王国的王储 Ryan 为了阻止战争，秘密潜入龙族领地。他假意投靠反派势力，暗中搜集其策划阴谋的证据。
在执行任务的过程中，Ryan 与宿敌——黑龙王 Derek——意外揭开了两人命中注定的童年羁绊。
从彼此敌对到并肩作战，他们携手对抗野心勃勃的 Kaos 及堕神残余势力，破解致命的血脉诅咒，粉碎挑拨双方的阴谋，并逐渐化解人类与龙族之间延续千年的仇恨。
最终，他们不仅为两个种族赢得了真正的和平，也收获了彼此相爱的圆满结局。
